title: IIR Filter
source_docs: Motor Control Blockset HDL Support/Signal Management/IIR_Filter.md
text: Implement infinite impulse response (IIR) filter, 4 inputs, 1 output, {Theoretical cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets Theoretical cutoff frequency of IIR filter 32.1525; {Filter type} sets the iIR filter type, {Filter coefficient}, {Filter coefficient value} sets the filter coefficient of IIR filter, {Initial state} sets how to provide initial state value Specify via, {Initial state value} sets the initial value of state, {External reset} sets the whether to provide external reset signal, {Display cutoff frequency} displays the cutoff frequency parameters and {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Filter coefficient
params.values: Filter coefficient input method Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Filter coefficient value
params.values: Filter coefficient of IIR filter 0.01 (default) | scalar in the range (0,1]

params.name: Initial state
params.values: Specify how to provide initial state value Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: External reset
params.values: Specify whether to provide external reset signal none (default) | active high resets to initial condition

params.name: Display cutoff frequency
params.values: Display the cutoff frequency parameters off (default) | on

params.name: Discrete step size (s)
params.values: Sample time after which block executes again 50e-6 (default) | scalar

params.name: Theoretical cutoff frequency (Hz)
params.values: Theoretical cutoff frequency of IIR filter 32.1525 | scalar
